By normalizing the conversation around death, the piece reduces the isolation often felt during the grieving process, providing a constructive psychological tool for the reader.

There is no plane error here. The WHO (the author), WHAT (the reflection), and WHY (meaning-making) are in alignment. The narrative is honest and does not require obfuscation to hold its weight.

Alethekanon:
This is a rare instance of high-integrity narrative. The author acknowledges the causal origin of her perspective—her father—and maintains a consistent, falsifiable emotional payload throughout the text.
